tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for joining! Today, we’ll talk about modern lifestyle. First, what do you think is the greatest advantage of the city you live in? Why do you like it?
tasks.analysis: 中文：谢谢你的参与！今天，我们来聊聊现代生活方式。首先，你认为你所居住的城市最大的优势是什么？你为什么喜欢它？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Some people prefer living in a big city. Other people prefer living in the countryside, away from urban areas. Which do you think is better and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。有些人更喜欢住在大城市。另一些人则更喜欢住在远离市区的乡村。你认为哪一种更好？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good point. Next, some people believe that technology has made people's lives more convenient. Others think that over-reliance on technology has brought more burdens to people's lives. What's your opinion on this issue?
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得有道理。下一个问题，有些人认为科技让人们的生活更加便利。另一些人则认为对科技的过度依赖给人们的生活带来了更多负担。你对此有何看法？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Great. Finally, What do you think people should do to enhance the experience of urban life?
tasks.analysis: 中文：很好。最后一个问题，你认为人们应该做些什么来提升城市生活的体验？
tasks.title: Interview
